articles.title: Fake IDs, dual lives & a dramatic escape: The 28-yr saga of killer Rajinder Bairagi
articles.description: The Delhi Police successfully arrested Rajinder Bairagi, a long-sought fugitive connected to a 1998 murder case. For nearly thirty years, he managed to evade law enforcement by living under a false identity in Madhya Pradesh. During the investigation, authorities also resolved two previously unsolved attempted murder cases from 1997 using leads tied to him. His elaborate disguise was ultimately dismantled following comprehensive surveillance operations.

articles.title: Stock Market Today Live Updates: Where are BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty50 headed today? Oil prices, global cues and more in focus
articles.full_text: Rupee weakened against the US dollar in the previous session, depreciating 16 paise to settle at 95.24. The currency came under pressure due to a slight recovery in the US Dollar Index, modest gains in US Treasury yields and continued foreign fund outflows. During the day, the rupee opened at 95.13 and traded in a range of 95.12 to 95.24 before ending at its weakest level of the session. Forex traders said softer crude oil prices limited the downside for rupee by easing concerns around India's import bill. According to Mirae Asset ShareKhan analyst Anuj Choudhary, expectations of a possible US-Iran agreement could support rupee, although any rebound in the dollar index or Treasury yields may restrict gains. According to analysts domestic equities have found support from multiple macroeconomic developments during the previous session. Vinod Nair, head of research at Geojit Investments, said crude oil prices and intensified diplomatic efforts to restore stability in the Middle East improved investor confidence. He added that the Reserve Bank of India's decision to maintain the repo rate at 5.25% for the fourth consecutive meeting, along with its neutral policy stance and constructive economic outlook, encouraged selective buying in banking and energy stocks. The central bank also marginally raised its GDP growth forecast for the current financial year to 6.7% while trimming its inflation projection to 5%. However, policymakers maintained that future rate decisions would remain dependent on incoming economic data and inflation trends. Benchmark equity indices ended on a mixed note in the previous trading session, with BSE Sensex outperforming NSE Nifty as buying in heavyweight stocks offset broader caution. The 30-share Sensex climbed 373.76 points, or 0.48%, to settle at 78,954.76 after remaining in positive territory throughout the day. Meanwhile, Nifty 50 traded in a narrow range and edged up just 11.35 points, or 0.05%, to close at 24,636. During the session, the index touched an intraday high of 24,677.05 and a low of 24,604.15. Market sentiment was supported by moderation in crude oil prices, optimism surrounding diplomatic efforts in the Middle East and buying in heavyweight stocks such as Reliance Industries and ICICI Bank, even as broader gains remained limited.

articles.description: HP Police Constable Recruitment 2026: The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission has extended the last date to apply for HP Police Constable Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates can now submit Online Recruitment Applications for 734 constable vacancies until August 21, 2026. The recruitment includes 491 male and 243 female posts. Class 12 pass candidates aged between 18 and 25 years can apply. The selection process comprises a Physical Test, Written Examination, Document Verification and Medical Examination.

articles.description: NMMSS Scholarship 2026-27: The Ministry of Education has opened fresh and renewal applications for the National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) for the 2026-27 academic year through the National Scholarship Portal. Eligible students can apply until August 31, 2026. The ministry has also announced the verification schedule for institute and district nodal officers. From this academic year, students may apply for one merit-based scholarship along with one or more welfare-based scholarship schemes, subject to eligibility.
